name: cat-meme-studio
description: Windows desktop app for generating Chinese cat meme short videos.
author: Cat Meme Studio

scripts.build:full: npm run typecheck && npm run build:app && electron-builder --win zip --config electron-builder.full.yml
scripts.build:portable: npm run typecheck && npm run build:app && electron-builder --win portable --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:dir: npm run typecheck && npm run build:app && electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.yml
